Estonia–Sweden revenue declined to EUR 85.3 million, while its segment loss improved to EUR 1.2 million.

verified_key_information_units.information: Liquidity position as at 31 Dec 2025: net debt EUR 432.4M (net debt/EBITDA 3.3), cash and cash equivalents EUR 13.5M, unused credit lines EUR 96.9M, total liquidity buffer EUR 110.4M.

candidate_sentences.text: The Group continued to reduce borrowings, with net debt broadly stable at EUR 432.4 million and the net debt-to-EBITDA ratio improving slightly to 3.3.
Cash and unused credit facilities provided a EUR 110.4 million liquidity buffer at year-end.

verified_key_information_units.information: Capital investments of EUR 33.0M in FY2025, mainly for maintenance and refurbishment of cruise ferries Baltic Princess and Silja Serenade, including technical upgrades, and IT systems improvement.

candidate_sentences.text: Capital expenditure increased to EUR 33.0 million, mainly for vessel maintenance, refurbishment, and IT systems.

verified_key_information_units.information: Dividends paid EUR 44.6M (EUR 0.06 per share) in 2025; Management Board proposed dividend of EUR 0.06 per share for 2026.

candidate_sentences.text: Despite the challenging year, the Board intends to propose a EUR 0.06 per share dividend for 2026.

verified_key_information_units.information: Q4 2025 results: passenger volume 1.3M (-0.3% YoY), revenue EUR 188.0M (+2.4% YoY), EBITDA EUR 27.6M (+7.3% YoY), net profit EUR 12.2M (vs net loss EUR 5.2M in Q4 2024).
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Results of Fourth Quarter section; Key Figures

candidate_sentences.text: Revenue increased 2.4% to EUR 188.0 million, EBITDA rose to EUR 27.6 million from EUR 25.7 million, and the Group generated EUR 12.2 million of net profit compared with a EUR 5.2 million loss a year earlier.

verified_key_information_units.information: Fleet status: 11 vessels operated at year-end (2 shuttle, 6 passenger, 3 chartered out); sale of three vessels optimizing cost base; three vessels chartered out with extended agreements; shuttle vessels transitioning to biomethane fuel.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Management Report vessel details; Letter from CEO on biomethane; Events section

candidate_sentences.text: Depreciation and amortisation declined by EUR 18.0 million to EUR 79.8 million, mainly because vessel useful lives were aligned to 45 years and three vessels were sold.
During the year, the Group sold the vessels Star I, Regal Star and Sailor, reduced vessels in lay-up to zero, and maintained three vessels under charter agreements.

details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary is internally coherent. It consistently describes a year of overall financial weakening (S1-S4) with specific supporting details about revenue, EBITDA, net profit, and margins. The summary logically explains the decline through external factors (S5) and segment performance (S6-S11), while also highlighting cost offsets (S12-S14) and fourth-quarter improvement (S16-S18). All statements build upon each other without contradiction. The organization flows from overall performance to drivers, segment results, cost dynamics, and year-end position. There is no unnecessary repetition, and all relationships (cause-effect, comparisons) are logically consistent within the text itself. The summary forms a clear narrative arc from annual decline to quarterly recovery.
